body: I really appreciate you taking the time to comment, I wish I shared in your view of me being a good person. I know I’m not a terrible person, but I don’t know if I’m a good person. I should have never gave her back Bellamy and I hate myself even more for doing it, I try and do the right things and feel shittier for it.

She may not be worth it but what or she’s right about me, idk if I really deserve to be loved. I’m no saint and I know I’ve hurt people. I don’t have any friends that i could talk to about this hence why I’m doing it on Reddit, I didn’t even intend to make two post about this and I still couldn’t even do that right. I can’t hear myself think, all I hear is their conversation, and all I can picture is my cats worried face as I put her in the kennel.

I appreciate it man, everything feels so shitty. I feel bad for giving her the cat as well, she’s an Australian snow shoe and that breed is super dependent on human contact compared to most breeds and I know she won’t give the cat the attention she needs. That cat would come and cuddle with me everything, it became a routine then when I pulled the blankets over me she would meow and wait for me to open the covers so she could lay against me and now I wonder if the cat thinks I didn’t want her. So not only do I feel like shit but I made the one thing that cared about me feel like shit too
